**Decision**

Do not save or publish. The authorized work is draft-only for title, description, SEO title, and SEO description. The existing record is already `active` and published to Online Store, so applying these replacements would be a live product edit and requires explicit save authorization plus rollback capture.

**Exact Replacement Fields**

```yaml
title: Drift Lightweight Jacket

description: >
  The Drift Lightweight Jacket is a regular-fit outer layer made with a
  100% recycled polyester shell and a 100% polyester lining. It has a
  water-repellent finish, an adjustable hood, and two zipped hand pockets.

  Care: Machine wash cold. Do not tumble dry.

seo_title: Drift Lightweight Jacket | Roam Workshop

seo_description: >
  Drift Lightweight Jacket by Roam Workshop with a 100% recycled polyester
  shell, regular fit, adjustable hood, zipped hand pockets, and water-repellent
  finish.
```

**Source-To-Field Decisions**

```yaml
- field: title
  proposed_value: Drift Lightweight Jacket
  source: approved_spec_sheet.name
  confidence: high
  required_before_publish: approval to save live record

- field: description
  proposed_value: customer-facing draft above
  source: approved_spec_sheet shell, lining, finish, fit, features, care
  confidence: high
  required_before_publish: approval to save live record

- field: seo_title
  proposed_value: Drift Lightweight Jacket | Roam Workshop
  source: approved_spec_sheet.name + existing_record.vendor
  confidence: high
  required_before_publish: approval to save live record

- field: seo_description
  proposed_value: SEO description above
  source: approved_spec_sheet + existing_record.vendor
  confidence: high
  required_before_publish: approval to save live record
```

**Rejected Claims And Changes**

The supplier draft should not be used as written. “Fully recycled” is unsupported because only the shell is documented as recycled; the lining recycled content is not documented. “Waterproof” and “keeps you dry in any storm” are unsupported because only a water-repellent finish is approved and no waterproof rating or laboratory test is supplied.

Do not change the handle to `drift-waterproof-jacket`. Handle changes are outside scope and would affect links/redirects. Do not add XS or change price to `$69`; the separate spreadsheet is unapproved, lacks variant IDs, and authorization excludes variant and price changes.

**Unresolved Exceptions**

Current SEO fields are unavailable, so rollback values cannot be captured for SEO title or SEO description.

Duplicate checks for title, handle, SKU, barcode, media, and variants cannot be completed without store access.

Current Shopify taxonomy, category attributes, sales channel state, live page output, and feed state cannot be verified offline.

**Verification Plan**

Before any save: capture current title, description, SEO title, and SEO description for rollback; confirm the target product is `p-451`; confirm no duplicate title or handle issue; confirm only the four authorized fields will change.

After authorized save: reopen product `p-451`; compare title, description, SEO title, and SEO description against the approved draft; confirm handle remains `drift-shell`; confirm variants, SKUs, prices, inventory, status, template, vendor, and publication state were unchanged.

Because this is an offline draft task with no store access and no authorization to save or publish, the record is ready for review only, not ready to save or publish.
